name: Covidence De-duplication Findings Fix Plan
description: Update DE_DUPLICATE_COV_PLAN.md so it explicitly addresses the review findings captured in DE_FINDINGS_FIX_PLAN.md.

userStories.title: Add identity and display contract
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the dedupe plan to define which article identity each system should use so that implementation does not keep overloading app.article.article_id.
acceptanceCriteria: Add an Identity And Display Contract section to DE_DUPLICATE_COV_PLAN.md.
The section distinguishes app.article.id, app.article_identifier.normalized_value, app.article_import_route.external_article_id, app.article.article_id, and source URL ownership.
Target Data Model, Project-Scoped Serving Metadata, Client Review Surfaces, and Phase 8 state that display and URL helpers must stop parsing source prefixes from app.article.article_id.
Re-read DE_DUPLICATE_COV_PLAN.md after editing and confirm this finding is represented as explicit plan content.
Re-read DE_FINDINGS_FIX_PLAN.md and confirm the edit does not contradict it.
No code tests are required unless code or test files are changed.

acceptanceCriteria: Main Files And Systems To Change lists PubMed and Europe PMC harvesters, preprint harvesters, import routes, and importer tests from DE_FINDINGS_FIX_PLAN.md.

The plan states that source article_id values from broad harvesters must not become canonical article identity.

userStories.title: Add strong identifier conflict rules
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want explicit multi-identifier conflict rules so that the matcher quarantines DOI, PMID, arXiv, bioRxiv, and medRxiv disagreements instead of silently merging wrong articles.
acceptanceCriteria: Matching Policy includes the rule that multiple strong identifiers can auto-merge only when all existing matches point to the same canonical article.
Matching Policy says conflicting strong identifiers across different canonical articles are quarantined as strong-identifier conflicts.

Unresolved Cases describes the required quarantine payload fields: source kind, import run id, source record key, conflicting identifier kinds, conflicting canonical article ids, and operator-review metadata.
Risks mentions that source batches can contain strong identifier conflicts that must not be silently collapsed.
Re-read DE_DUPLICATE_COV_PLAN.md after editing and confirm this finding is represented as explicit plan content.
Re-read DE_FINDINGS_FIX_PLAN.md and confirm the edit does not contradict it.

userStories.title: Add concurrency and transaction policy
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the dedupe plan to define concurrent import behavior so that retries and racing imports remain idempotent and do not create duplicate canonical articles.
acceptanceCriteria: Performance And Scale Requirements or Bulk Import Staging And Checkpointing includes an import-run lease or equivalent single-writer guard per source or import route when needed.
Phase 2 or Phase 3 states that canonical article creation, identifier insertion, and import-record insertion run in bounded transactions.
The plan treats UNIQUE(kind, normalized_value) on app.article_identifier as the final arbiter for concurrent writers.
The plan says identifier insert conflicts must re-read the winning row and either continue with the same canonical article or quarantine a concurrent strong-identifier conflict.
Migration Notes or Risks says retries must be idempotent by source_kind, import_run_id, source_record_key, and source_record_hash.
Re-read DE_DUPLICATE_COV_PLAN.md after editing and confirm this finding is represented as explicit plan content.
Re-read DE_FINDINGS_FIX_PLAN.md and confirm the edit does not contradict it.

userStories.title: Add source record history policy
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the plan to separate current route membership from import-run provenance so that repeated harvests and multiple source rows are handled deterministically.
acceptanceCriteria: Import-Scoped Article Record states that app.article_import_route represents current article membership for a route and latest compact import-scoped payload.
The plan defines import_run_id, source_record_key, and source_record_hash as provenance for the latest write.
Bulk Import Staging And Checkpointing or Phase 3 says repeated harvests update import-scoped records only when source_record_hash changes.
The plan defines behavior for multiple source rows in one import route resolving to the same canonical article: deterministic metadata merge or child row table.
Open Decisions includes whether source-row history needs app.article_import_route_row or a dedicated import-run row table.
Re-read DE_DUPLICATE_COV_PLAN.md after editing and confirm this finding is represented as explicit plan content.

userStories.title: Add identifier normalization contract
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want exact identifier normalization rules in the plan so that matching behavior is deterministic and covered by tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Article Identifier Table or Matching Policy defines normalization rules for DOI, PMID, PMCID if supported, arXiv, bioRxiv, medRxiv, and URL-derived identifiers.
The arXiv rule explicitly decides whether version suffixes like v1 and v2 match the same canonical article.
The PMCID rule explicitly decides whether PMCID is a strong identifier or source metadata only.
Phase 0 requires tests for boundary cases, malformed values, duplicate values in one batch, and conflicts across identifier kinds.
Quality Gates include targeted identifier normalization tests.

userStories.title: Make performance gates concrete
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want concrete performance and retry gates in the plan so that 50,000-record Covidence imports and million-row broad-source imports have pass/fail criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: Performance And Scale Requirements or Quality Gates includes pass criteria for a 50,000-record Covidence import: bounded chunks, no per-row canonical lookup, no duplicate canonical rows, and memory under the configured budget.
Quality Gates includes pass criteria for one million identifier-bearing broad-source rows: staged matching in chunks, Covidence-created article linking, and resumability after interruption.
Quality Gates states identifier matching must use indexed joins or chunked IN lookups against normalized identifier tables, not JSON scans or full app.article scans.
Quality Gates states broad-source imports with no project-linked changes must not mark unrelated project marts dirty.
Quality Gates states re-running an interrupted import must not create additional canonical articles or duplicate import-scoped records.
Open Decisions includes exact local thresholds for wall-clock budget, default chunk size, checkpoint interval, and memory ceiling.

The plan states which id each API, mart, export, snapshot, and UI surface should expose.
The plan lists broad-source harvesters, comparison projects, and judgment snapshot systems as affected systems.
The plan defines strong-identifier conflicts, concurrent import conflict behavior, and source-record history behavior.
The plan includes identifier normalization rules and targeted tests.
The plan includes concrete performance pass/fail checks for 50,000-record Covidence imports and million-row broad-source imports.
The plan keeps browser and desktop verification requirements for shared UI and runtime-path changes.
